title: Leadership
metaDescription: Sato Engineering & Infrastructure Limited is led by its founder, Engr. Wale Osamiluyi, and assembles a dedicated project team for each job from its network of engineers, technicians, foremen and specialists.

header.alt: Sato engineer reading a drawing at a dam site, tower crane and formwork behind

sections.heading: How we build project teams
body: Sato runs a small core leadership team and assembles a dedicated project team for each job. The core group carries responsibility for the contract, the programme and the client relationship from award through to handover.

Around that core we draw engineers, technicians, foremen and specialists from Sato's network, matched to the scope and location of the work. A client gets the expertise the job actually needs rather than whoever happens to be free, and the same people stay with the project to completion.
